title: Pinlock 120 Max Vision Lens
features: Pinlock's flagship 120 level anti-fog technology engineered for MotoGP and extreme wet conditions
Precision airtight silicon bead creates a thermal insulating barrier preventing visor condensation
Max Vision wide-angle profile fits seamlessly into visor recess without edge distortion
Easy to install and swap using helmet shield eccentric adjustment pins
description:
Engineered to withstand harsh ultraviolet radiation and dense condensation, the Pinlock 120 Max Vision Lens from Pinlock elevates visual clarity across demanding weather conditions. Built with Hydrophobic Rain-Shedding Exterior Coating with Perimeter Airtight Seal, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Toolless quick-release pivot lever swap in 10 seconds).

The Pinlock 120 Max Vision Lens is an essential visual clarity upgrade from Pinlock. By delivering edge-to-edge optical fidelity and bulletproof fog prevention, it dramatically improves situational awareness across unpredictable climates.
